name: NZD Command Center — Reserve Bank of New Zealand / New Zealand Debt Management liquidity desk
central_bank: Reserve Bank of New Zealand (RBNZ) — Te Pūtea Matua
treasury: The Treasury / New Zealand Debt Management (NZDM) — Crown Settlement Account (CSA) at the RBNZ; no daily cash statement
monetary_sovereignty: full (NZD issuer; floating exchange rate; NZGB issuance in NZD)
framework: MMT/Mosler: floor system — ALL settlement cash remunerated at the OCR (Overnight Deposit Rate = OCR), ceiling = Overnight Reverse Repurchase Facility at OCR + 50 bp. Settlement cash is shrinking as LSAP bonds mature / are sold to NZDM (NZ$415m per month) and is now re-supplied by weekly full-allotment reverse-repo OMOs at OCR + 10 bp (7 and 28 days, Thursdays, since 2026-04-02). Quantity is only a dead-man switch; the RBNZ defines 'ample' by observable conditions (short rates near the OCR, smooth settlement). Crown spending/taxes move settlement cash through the CSA; NZDM tenders (T-bills Tuesday, bonds Thursday) drain reserves on settlement without changing net financial assets

units.note: RBNZ XLSX deliver NZ$ millions (D3/D12/R1/R3/C5/C50) except LSAP sales and BMLS holdings in NZ$ (face value) → divide by 1e6; NZDM tender files in NZ$ millions

fiscal.equivalence_note: No daily cash statement (DTS analog) in New Zealand. Daily footprint = desk derivation autonomous_flow_daily (Layer 1); weekly = NZDM tender results (issuance drain on T+3 settlement) and the monthly tender schedule (known drain dates); monthly = R3 Crown settlement accounts (14th) and D10 government cash influence (end of following month); Treasury monthly financial statements ~6 weeks lag = confirmation. mmt_note.text: Crown spending credits settlement accounts (creates net financial assets); taxes debit them; NZGB and T-bill tenders drain settlement cash on settlement without changing the private sector's net financial assets — they swap reserves for bonds. New Zealand publishes no daily Crown cash figure: the desk reads the Crown through the residual movement of settlement cash after RBNZ operations, and confirms it monthly with D10 / R3.

rates.title: 4 · Rates & money market — OCR corridor (floor = ODR = OCR, ceiling = ORRF +50), bank bills, NZGB curve, swaps
rates.equivalence_note: B2 daily close (T-1, 15:00 NZT). Floor system: the overnight interbank rate should sit at/just above the OCR; it is published only on days with trades (sparse) → the daily stress spread is the 30-day bank bill − OCR with a persistence rule, corrected for hike pricing by the 90-day bill and 1-year swap; the OMO price is fixed (OCR + 10) so price stress shows up in ORRF use and bills, not in the operation | v0.2: B2 bank bills are NZFMA/LSEG closing rates (the 10:20 NZT BKBM fixing itself is published by NZFBF; public delayed feed unverified — pending); NZ OIS has no public feed (not available, not proxied)

bank_bill_30d_minus_ocr_bps.note: STRESS SPREAD (daily). Floor logic: bills should trade near the OCR (+5–15 bp in calm conditions per Qwen/DeepSeek, unverified); classified RAW by percentile (window since the cycle start 2026-07-08 or 250 sessions, whichever is longer, min_n 120) plus absolute anchors; SCARCITY needs friction_confirmed (overnight ≥ OCR+10 when published, or ORRF > 0) and hike pricing not being the driver (N3)

overnight_interbank_minus_ocr_bps.note: the true floor test, sparse; classified when present

bank_bill_90d_minus_ocr_bps.note: BKBM − OCR (V3.1 signal): term premium + hike pricing

hike_pricing_bps.note: CONTEXT ONLY (N3, CodeWord): the 1-year swap discounts ~12 months of moves and over-corrects a 30-day bill; no public NZ OIS 1–3 m feed exists to do it properly → nothing is subtracted from the stress spread; hike pricing is displayed next to it and used by the SCARCITY gate ('not explained by hike pricing' = bill_curve_slope_bps > 0 and hike_pricing_bps ≥ p80)

bond_swap_spread_10y_bps.note: NZGB supply / offshore demand gauge (positive and rising = bonds cheapening vs swaps = supply indigestion)

friction_confirmed.formula: bank_bill_30d_minus_ocr_bps ≥ WATCH for 3 sessions AND (overnight_interbank_minus_ocr_bps ≥ 10 on a published day within the window OR orrf_usage_daily > 0)
friction_confirmed.note: price stress needs the overnight market or the ceiling facility to confirm

floor_leak.note: trading below the floor = non-ESAS cash with no OCR access; rare

bank_bill_30d_minus_ocr_bps.note: DESK PROPOSAL: +20 bp on 2026-09-07 with the hike just delivered and another priced; absolute anchors 25/40/60 to recalibrate after 120 sessions (N3)

regime.weights_note: v0.1 PROPOSAL: settlement cash + OMO reliance carry the NZD story (0.40); price confirmation 0.30; fiscal 0.15 (weekly tenders + monthly D10/R3, derived daily footprint); banking 0.15 (monthly, housing-credit economy). To be triangulated

rules.LIQUIDITY_SCARCITY: PRICE-GATED ONLY: bank_bill_30d_minus_ocr_bps ≥ STRESS persistent AND friction_confirmed (overnight ≥ OCR + 10 or ORRF used) AND NOT (bill_curve_slope_bps > 0 and hike_pricing_bps ≥ p80); settlement cash anchors are dead-man switches, never triggers (N1/N3)
rules.LIQUIDITY_DRAIN: general regime: central bank AND treasury both DRAIN, or dual-weighted score ≤ drain threshold (regime.dual)
rules.LIQUIDITY_INJECTION: general regime: both INJECTION, or dual-weighted score ≥ injection threshold (regime.dual)
rules.NEUTRAL: otherwise (including unresolved conflicts inside the thresholds)

OMO_DEPENDENCE.note: NZD-specific: the system is transitioning from LSAP-created reserves to RBNZ-supplied reserves; HIGH = reserves scarce enough that banks lean on the weekly operation while bills and tenders show strain | N10: each condition must hold on 2 consecutive observations

regime.flags_note: v0.2: FX_SWAP_ACTIVE, TBILL_UNDERALLOCATED, COUPON_PAYMENT_DAY, BOND_MATURITY_DAY, LSAP_SALE_DAY, TAX_DAY added (N9); FOREIGN_DEMAND_FADE stays monthly (D30) with daily canaries bond_swap_spread_10y and long_end_turnover_share (N7). INJECTION/DRAIN kept (desk-standard cross-currency enum: they describe reserve FLOW, scarcity is price-gated) — CodeWord's removal rejected (N11). Score arithmetic: max |weighted| = 0.40×1.5 + 0.30×1.5 + 0.15×0.5 + 0.15×1.0 = 1.275 → ±0.5 reachable

dual.rule: three regimes per currency: central_bank (block score), fiscal (block score), general = agreement (both inject → LIQUIDITY_INJECTION, both drain → LIQUIDITY_DRAIN); a conflict is resolved by the dual-weighted score against general_thresholds; price gates (LIQUIDITY_SCARCITY, FLOOR_FRICTION) override the general regime

regime.composite_note: weights (4 blocks) now produce the desk composite score for context; the reported regime is the general regime (central bank + treasury)

status_rules.note: daily = T-1 at 15:00 NZT (= 03:00 UTC NZST / 02:00 UTC NZDT) → the 04:00 UTC lane sees T-1; NZ public holidays leave gaps (no release); holiday-aware: expected data dates skip nz_public_holidays (N13)

reconciliation.rule: sum(autonomous_flow_daily over month) ≈ D10 government cash influence + reserve bank transactions + FX (±15%)
R1 total assets == total liabilities + equity
